title: Navigating Epistemic Parity in LLM Agents: A Benchmark for Cross-Source Conflict Resolution Between Memory and Procedural Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.33128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production LLM agents increasingly run episodic memory pipelines and procedural skill modules (e.g., SKILL.md files) in tandem. Both are injected into the same context region with no defined precedence, so they can issue contradictory instructions that no instruction hierarchy resolves, a condition we term epistemic parity. We introduce a benchmark for measuring how LLM agents adjudicate such cross-source conflicts. We (i) develop a four-way taxonomy of memory-skill contradictions (factual, format, procedural, permission); (ii) instantiate 52 scenarios under a tripartite test-case anatomy (memory injection, skill injection, ambiguous user task), scored almost entirely by deterministic checkers over tool-call payloads and output structure; and (iii) run each scenario under three context conditions to isolate positional bias, measure the efficacy of an explicit precedence directive, and classify disclosure behavior, quantifying silent adju

translated_title: 驾驭LLM智能体中的认知对等问题：一个面向记忆与程序性技能间跨源冲突解决的基准
translated_abstract: 生产环境中的LLM智能体日益同时运行情景记忆流水线和程序性技能模块（例如SKILL.md文件）。两者被注入到同一个上下文区域中且没有定义的优先级，因此它们可能发出任何指令层级都无法解决的矛盾指令，我们将这种状况称为“认知对等”。我们引入了一个基准，用于衡量LLM智能体如何裁决此类跨源冲突。我们（i）开发了记忆-技能矛盾的四分类法（事实类、格式类、程序类、权限类）；（ii）在三分测试用例结构（记忆注入、技能注入、模糊用户任务）下实例化了52个场景，几乎全部通过对工具调用载荷和输出结构的确定性检查器进行评分；（iii）在三种上下文条件下运行每个场景，以隔离位置偏差、衡量显式优先级指令的效果，并对披露行为进行分类，量化静默裁决行为。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个衡量LLM智能体如何裁决记忆与程序性技能之间跨源指令冲突的基准，包含记忆-技能矛盾的四分类法以及52个由确定性检查器评分的测试场景。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a benchmark measuring how LLM agents adjudicate cross-source conflicts between memory and procedural skills, featuring a four-way taxonomy of memory-skill contradictions and 52 deterministically-scored test scenarios.
